verdict.line: You lose if he catches you with Q (Thundering Smash) and lands a second W (Frenzied Maul) before Feint is up; you win if you absorb his all-in with W and out-sustain him with Vorpal Blade.

brief.thesis: Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) rewards him for landing two hits on the same mark, and Shen's W (Feint) exists specifically to erase that exact burst window if timed on the first hit. Neither champion has real poke, so this is a stalemate of tank mechanics rather than a lane with a clean bully. The 53.5% Shen win rate over 1248 games (above his 51.4% baseline) comes from macro, not lane trades — Shen's R (Stand United) gives him global relevance a pure laner like Volibear can't answer.

theirWindow.when: Right after his first W lands
theirWindow.what: He will try to recast W (Frenzied Maul) on you immediately for bonus damage and a heal — step back or trade through it fast instead of standing still for the second hit.

yourWindow.when: Whenever his Q is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without Thundering Smash (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s cd) he has no gap-closer or stun, so push up and land Q (Vorpal Blade) at 475 range freely since he can't punish the engage.

start.why: 52.4% win rate over 887 games — the regen and poke-block covers Shen through Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) chip damage while Ki Strike stacks build between fights.

boots.why: 53.8% win rate over 749 games — tenacity shortens the stun from Q (Thundering Smash) and the magic resist blunts the bonus magic damage his passive, The Relentless Storm, adds to his attacks.

core.why: First piece of the strongest measured path (60.4% over 91 games) — the health scaling and wave-clear let Shen hold lane without needing to win trades.
Second item in that same 60.4% path — adds the sustain and tenacity Shen needs to keep absorbing W (Frenzied Maul) pokes.
Completes the highest-winrate path on record — punishes Volibear's W heal-back by reflecting damage whenever he autos into you.

situational.when: the enemy team is stacking magic damage alongside Volibear's on-attack burn
you need the active slow to land taunt combos onto a kiting target
the game runs long and you want more raw health for teamfight taunts
Volibear rushes lifesteal or heal-heavy items and you need early grievous wounds

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in both top rune pages (55.8% and 51.9% win rate) — it heals Shen off every auto onto the wave and Volibear, offsetting his W (Frenzied Maul) poke while scaling Shen's max health for free.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 71% of games at a 56.2% win rate — Ignite shuts down Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) self-heal in extended trades, and Flash answers his Q (Thundering Smash) gap-close when he commits.

playing.title: Shield his Q, not his W
playing.detail: Save W (Feint) for when Volibear engages with Q (Thundering Smash) — it's his only stun and gap-closer, so absorbing that single burst is worth more than popping Feint on a cheap 5s-cooldown W poke.

playing.title: Disengage once marked
playing.detail: After his first W (Frenzied Maul) lands, he's one recast away from bonus damage and a heal — back off or trade through immediately instead of standing still for the second hit.

playing.title: Threaten taunt at range
playing.detail: E (Shadow Dash) dashes to a location and taunts any enemy champion it passes through, on a 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown — use it to punish overextensions or peel him off an ally once it's up.

playing.title: Farm Ki Strike on the wave
playing.detail: Shen's passive cooldown drops every time he attacks a minion, monster, or champion — weave autos onto the wave between trades so the empowered hit is ready when Volibear commits.

playing.title: Sustain with Vorpal Blade
playing.detail: Q, on a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s cooldown at 475 range, life-taps Shen and heals allies who follow up — fire it on cooldown since Volibear has no ranged poke to punish you for stepping up.

playing.title: Watch his tower-disabling ult
playing.detail: R (Stormbringer), cooldown 160/135/110/110/110s, temporarily disables nearby towers when he lands — don't let him stack dive pressure under yours once he hits level 6.

playing.title: Roam off a contained lane
playing.detail: Neither of you can solo-kill the other here, so once R (Stand United) is up on its 200/180/160/160/160s cooldown, use it to shield and teleport to skirmishes elsewhere on the map.

brief.patchCaveat: Item paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and every win-rate figure above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and trade reads are my own tactical analysis built on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Absorb the damage on Volibear’s (Q) with [W]. Avoid (W) after being Wounded by Volibear as it deals more damage. Be careful of dives as Volibear’s (R) disables turrets, paying close attention on managing your health at all times.
